vosi_yoga: There is a planet other than Moon in the 12th house from Sun
You will be skillful, charitable, famous, learned and strong.
nipuna_yoga: Sun and Mercury are together (in one sign).

You will be intelligent and skillful in all works. You will be well known, respected and happy.\n This yoga is the most powerful in divisional charts like D-10. In rasi chart also, it can give results if Mercury is not combust.
sunaphaa_yoga: There are planets other than Sun in the 2nd house from Moon
You will become a person of authority or an equal. You are intelligent, wealthy and famous. You will have self-earned wealth.
sarpa_yoga: Three quadrants are occupied by natural malefic planets.
Sarpa means serpent. Classically counted among the inauspicious combinations, associated with hardship, dependence for sustenance, and harshness in temperament.
daama_yoga: The seven planets occupy exactly 6 distinct signs among them.
One born with this yoga is very rich and famous. This person has many children. This person has many gems. This person helps others. Daama means a wreath. Some authors call this Daamini yoga.
asubha_yoga: Lagna has malefics or has “paapa kartari or maleefics in 12th and 2nd house from Lagna.
Asubha means inauspicious. Counted among the inauspicious combinations, classically associated with strong desires and with living upon the wealth of others.
hari_yoga: If benefics occupy the 2nd, 12th and 8th houses counted from the 2nd lord, then this yoga is present.

One born with this yoga is happy, learned and blessed with wealth and children. Hari is a name of Lord Vishnu. The 2nd house is the house of food and money and it is a trine from karma sthana – the 10th house. It stands for sustenance and its lord represents Hari – Sustainer of Hindu Trinity – in a chart.
vasumathi_yoga: If benefics occupy upachayas, then this yoga is present.
For it to give full results, malefics should not occupy upachayas and the benefics occupying upachayas should be strong. One born with this yoga has abundant wealth. Vasumati means earth.
vanchana_chora_bheethi_yoga: The Lagna is occupied by a malefic with Gulika in a trine; or Gulika is associated with the lords of the kendras and trines (1st, 4th, 7th, 10th, 5th and 9th); or the Lagna lord is conjoined with Rahu, Saturn or Ketu.
Vanchana Chora Bheethi: classically associated with apprehension of deception or loss through others.
harihara_brahma_yoga: Benefics are placed in the 2nd, 8th, and 12th houses from the Lord of the 9th.
You will be a truthful person, an eloquent speaker, and highly learned in various sciences and scriptures.
dama_yoga: All seven planets are distributed among six different signs.
You will be a philanthropist, helpful to others, courageous, and very wealthy.
dharidhra_yoga_149: Lord of Lagna associated with 6th, 8th, or 12th lord and subjected to malefic aspects.
Classically associated with financial hardship and constrained resources.
dharidhra_yoga_152: Natural malefics (not owning 9th or 10th) in Lagna associated with or aspected by maraka lords (L2/L7).
Classically associated with financial hardship and constrained resources.
sareera_soukhya_yoga: The Lagna lord, Jupiter, or Venus is placed in a Kendra house.
You will enjoy excellent physical health, a long life, and luxury.
rogagrastha_yoga: Either the Lagna lord is in the Lagna together with the lord of the 6th, 8th or 12th; or a weak Lagna lord occupies a kendra or a trikona.
Classically associated with a weak constitution and susceptibility to recurring ailments.
krisanga_yoga_113: The Navamsa Lagna is owned by a dry planet AND malefics join the Rasi Lagna.
Krisanga: classically associated with a lean or slender bodily build.
dehasthoulya_yoga_114: Lagna Lord and its Navamsa Lord both occupy watery signs (in Rasi).
Dehasthoulya: classically associated with a heavy or well-built bodily frame.
swaveeryaddhana_yoga: Any one of: (130) the Lagna lord, being the strongest planet, occupies a kendra in conjunction with Jupiter, and the 2nd lord is in Vaiseshikamsa; (131) the lord of the sign occupied by the lord of the navamsa that the Lagna lord is in is strong, and is in a kendra or trine from the 2nd lord or in his own or exaltation sign; (132) the 2nd lord is in a kendra or trine from the Lagna lord, or the 2nd lord, being a benefic, is in deep exaltation or in conjunction with an exalted planet.
You will earn wealth solely through your own efforts, hard work, and personal prowess, without much ancestral help.
anthya_vayasi_dhana_yoga: The lords of the 2nd, 9th, and 11th houses are placed in the 12th, 6th, or 8th houses from each other but associated with benefics.
You will accumulate and enjoy great wealth and prosperity during the later years or the final stage of your life.
durmukha_yoga: Malefic planets (Saturn, Rahu, Ketu) occupy the 2nd house.
Durmukha means hard-faced. Classically associated with a stern countenance.
bhratruvriddhi_yoga: The 3rd lord or Mars is associated with a benefic planet or placed in a benefic sign/Navamsha.
You will have an increase in the number of brothers and sisters, and enjoy a harmonious relationship with them.
parakrama_yoga: The lord of the 3rd should join a benefic navamsa being aspected by (or conjoined with) benefic planets, and Mars should occupy benefic signs.
The individual will be highly courageous, valorous, and possesses great physical and mental strength to overcome obstacles.
yuddha_praveena_yoga: The lord of the Navamsa occupied by the 3rd lord's Navamsa lord is placed in its own Varga.
The person becomes a capable strategist and an expert in warfare and tactical combat.
satkathadisravana_yoga: The 3rd house is a benefic sign aspected by benefic planets, and the 3rd lord joins a benefic amsa (conjoins with or aspected by a benefic).
You have a natural inclination toward listening to righteous stories, spiritual discourses, and virtuous conversations.
bandhu_pujya_yoga_194: 194 - The 4th house or the 4th lord should have the association or aspect of Jupiter.
The person will be respected by his relatives and friends.
bandhubhisthyaktha_yoga: 195. The 4th lord must be associated with malefics or occupy evil shashtiamsas or join inimical or debilitation signs.
Classically read as an indication of estrangement from relatives; Raman adds that the native may be misunderstood by associates and kin through no fault of his own.
matrunasa_yoga_198: 198 - The Moon should be hemmed in between, associated with or aspected by evil planets.
Classically read as an indication of a short life for the mother, judged from affliction to the Moon and the 4th lord; Raman notes that benefic aspect on the Moon delays the indication.
kapata_yoga_202: 202 - The 4th house must be joined by a malefic and the 4rh lord must be associated with or aspected by malefics or be hemmed in between malefics.
Kapata means guile. Classically associated with concealment of one's true intent.
nishkapata_yoga_205: 205 - The 4th house must be occupied by a benefic, or a planet in exaltation, friendly or own house,or the 4th house must be a benefic sign.
The person will be pure-hearted and hates secrecy and hypocrisy.
vahana_yoga_209: 209 - The lord of Lagna must join the 4th, 11th or the 9th.
The native will acquire material comforts and conveyances.
suputhra_yoga: 226 - Jupiter is lord of 5th house (=Lagna in Le/Sc) and Sun in favorable position (own, exalted,friendly sign)
The native will have a worthy child.
buddhimaturya_yoga: 231 - If the 5th lord, being a benefic, is either aspected by another benefic or occupies a benefic sign, the above yoga is given rise to.
The person will be a man of great intelligence and character.
satkalatra_yoga: 239 - The lord of the 7th or Venus should join or be aspected by Jupiter or Mercury.
The native's wife will be noble and virtuous.
vrana_yoga: 265 - The 6th lord, being a malefic, should occupy the Lagna, 8th or 1Oth. Impacted organs depending on 6th lord: Sun- Spleen,heart. Moon-Oesophagus, alimentary canal. Mars-Genitals, left cerebral hemisphere, red colouring matter in blood,rectum. Mercury- Nerves, right cerebral hemisphere, cerebro-spinal-system, bronchial tubes, ears, tongue. Jupiter- Liver, supra-renals. Venus- Throat, kidneys, uterus, ovaries. Saturn- Teeth, skin, vagus nerve. Rahu- Pituitary body. Kethu- Pineal glands.

Vrana denotes a wound or sore. Raman reads this combination as an indication of malignant disease, the seat located from the planet involved (Sun - head, Moon - face, Mars - throat, neck or rectum, Mercury - lower stomach, Jupiter - nose, Venus - eyes, Saturn - legs, Rahu and Ketu - abdomen).
mathibhramana_yoga_294: 294 - The Moon and Mercury should be in a kendra, aspected by or conjoined with any other planet.
Classically associated with disturbance of mind and clarity of thought.
khalwata_yoga: 295 - The ascendant must be a malefic sign or Sagittarius or Taurus aspected by malefic planets.

doshas.Kala Sarpa Dosha: There is no Kala Sarpa Dosha in this horoscope.
doshas.Manglik Dosha:
According to classical reckoning, Mars occupying the 1st, 2nd, 4th, 7th, 8th or 12th house from the reference point constitutes this combination, the houses counted varying by regional tradition. Classically associated with force and friction in matters of partnership, and with a temperament that asks for patience from both sides. Classical texts set out several conditions under which the indication is held to be cancelled or much reduced.

12th is the House of conjugal bliss and joy. When Mars gets placed in this House, the native can become restless and aggressive, and suffer the loss of self-esteem. In the process, the peace and happiness of their marital bond will get hit, and life may turn miserable.

Though there is a Mars dosha placement in this chart, the classical exceptions listed below are held to cancel or greatly reduce the indication.

Mars is in association or aspected by Jupiter or Saturn

When Mars is in movable house, it reduces effects

If Lagnam is in Cancer or Leo, then Mars is yoga karaka and therefore will not cause dosha.
doshas.Pitru Dosha:
Pitru Dosha is described as an obligation carried down the ancestral line. It is reckoned when the Sun or Moon is in conjunction with, or aspected by, Rahu or Ketu, and classical texts treat the indication as more pronounced when that combination falls in the 1st, 5th, 8th or 9th house. Classically associated with obstruction in matters of lineage and continuity, alongside an indication of duties owed to the forebears. Remedial observances are prescribed for it. There is pitru dosha in this horoscope for the following reasons:

Either sun, moon, rahu or ketu has been afflicted by malefic planets like Mars or Saturn
